content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the registration form given (as annexed) with the notice. Attach the most recent CV and soft copies of mark sheets/certificates supporting academic qualification/experience. Consolidate all soft copies into a single PDF document. E-mail it to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected] . Use the subject line Application for JRF. Send before 11 December 2026, 5 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 11 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: INR 37,000 + 20% HRA per month (consolidated) = Rs. 44,400 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Essential: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical/Production/Automobile/Chemical/Aerospace Engineering/related areas with valid GATE / NET score. Desirable: Master's degree in Thermal Engineering or related areas.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant should be an Indian national. Degrees should be from recognized universities. Valid GATE / NET score required.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Online interview. Eligible candidates notified by email after shortlisting. Interview held online on 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement on contract basis for a research project. Duration one year, extendable up to six months based on performance and availability of fund. Salary released based on the availability of fund.
